paper.title: ESI-Bench: Towards Embodied Spatial Intelligence that Closes the Perception-Action Loop
paper.data: OmniGibson-grounded benchmark with 10 task categories, 29 subcategories, and 3,081 embodied spatial questions that require perception, locomotion, and manipulation decisions.
paper.method: recasts spatial intelligence as an active perception-action loop, evaluates embodied agents under controlled task families, and measures gains from active exploration versus passive observation.
paper.task: answer embodied spatial questions that require choosing how to move, inspect, and manipulate the environment to uncover hidden spatial facts.
paper.novelty: moves spatial intelligence benchmarking from passive or oracle-view settings into an embodied action loop where the agent must actively gather the evidence needed for reasoning.
paper.project_relevance: Strong benchmark reference for whether generated or reconstructed worlds preserve the active spatial structure needed for embodied decision-making.

paper.title: EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI
paper.data: sim-ready asset, scene, and task-world generation pipeline with public Hugging Face collection and dataset for cross-simulator embodied world construction.
paper.method: unified generative world engine that composes sim-ready assets, editable scenes, task-driven worlds, dialogue-based state editing, and cross-simulator export into one closed-loop pipeline.
paper.task: turn text, images, and dialogue instructions into executable multi-room 3D worlds that can be deployed across major simulators for embodied learning.
paper.novelty: pushes embodied world generation from isolated assets toward a reusable, agentic world engine that keeps affordances, state, layout stability, and simulator interfaces aligned.
paper.project_relevance: Very strong fit for the repository’s interactive generation branch because it connects asset generation, affordance/state retention, and executable world assembly.

paper.title: Interactive World Simulator for Robot Policy Training and Evaluation
paper.data: moderate-scale robot interaction dataset driving an action-conditioned video world model that supports multiple manipulation tasks and an interactive online demo.
paper.method: uses consistency models for both latent dynamics prediction and image decoding to build a fast, stable action-conditioned world simulator for closed-loop robot policy training and evaluation.
paper.task: simulate long-horizon robot interaction rollouts quickly enough and stably enough that policies can be trained and evaluated inside the learned world model.
paper.novelty: targets the missing middle ground between slow pixel-rollout world models and physics engines by treating the learned model itself as an interactive simulator for policy loops.
paper.project_relevance: High-value reference for learned world simulators that can sit directly inside embodied training and evaluation loops rather than only generating showcase videos.

paper.title: World Pilot: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models with World-Action Priors
paper.data: LIBERO-Plus and real-robot manipulation evaluations paired with a world-action prior and public Hugging Face model release.
paper.method: injects a World-Action Model into a VLA through latent steering at the perception layer and action steering at the trajectory/action layer.
paper.task: improve manipulation policy quality by giving VLA policies compact anticipatory priors about scene evolution and motion.
paper.novelty: shows a concrete way to route world-model priors into a VLA without forcing slow explicit pixel rollouts at action time.
paper.project_relevance: Excellent fit for the world-action-model branch because it operationalizes how a learned world prior can improve a deployed VLA policy.

paper.title: Being-H0.7: A Latent World-Action Model from Egocentric Videos
paper.data: large-scale egocentric video pretraining paired with robot-control evaluation and public code for a latent world-action model.
paper.method: learns a latent world-action model that carries future-aware interaction structure from egocentric videos into a deployable action prior without explicit pixel rollout at test time.
paper.task: improve robot control by giving policies future-aware latent dynamics and task-progress signals extracted from dense video structure.
paper.novelty: keeps the predictive benefits of world modeling while moving the reasoning substrate from expensive pixel prediction into a compact latent control interface.
paper.project_relevance: Useful anchor for compact world-action priors that keep embodied reasoning in the control loop without paying full pixel-rollout cost.

paper.title: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
paper.data: omnimodal physical-AI release surface spanning language, image, video, audio, and action sequences with public model cards and source code.
paper.method: unified mixture-of-transformers world-model family that jointly processes and generates multimodal physical-world sequences, subsuming VLMs, video generators, world simulators, and world-action models.
paper.task: support understanding, generation, simulation, and action inside one omnimodal world-model stack for physical AI use cases.
paper.novelty: collapses several previously separate embodied model classes into one omnimodal world-model family with flexible input-output configurations.
paper.project_relevance: High-impact anchor for world-model systems that unify perception, simulation, and action rather than treating them as separate modules.
